description: Use this when someone wants a study's conversations as a file: exports them as a CSV and returns a private download link that works for 60 minutes. Completed respondents only unless include_incomplete is true. Get study_id from gather_list_studies.

end_date.description: Only conversations up to this day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

include_incomplete.description: Also include pending, screened-out, quota, quality and fraud respondents (default false).

start_date.description: Only conversations from this day on, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

name: gather_export_responses
title: Export a study's responses
